context.body: The night remembered in later Scripture
context.label: Event location

observations.body: Signs at Zoan move through water, insects, frogs, crops, hail, livestock, angels of evil, and firstborn.
observations.label: Plague movement

observations.body: Egypt receives the plagues while God’s own people are led like sheep through wilderness.
observations.label: People and flock

observations.body: Sea passage leads toward a holy border and nations displaced from inherited territory.
observations.label: Destination

payload.posture: Stay with this witness’s people, objects, speech, sequence, and stated connections before moving to another account or later use.
payload.tension: The firstborn death is neither the beginning nor the end of this retelling; it turns the plague sequence toward protected departure and land.
payload.title: The signs in Egypt lead from firstborn death to shepherded departure
